body:
Root cause: .bashrc's stale GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI=true conflicted with ~/.gemini/settings.json's gemini-api-key auth mode. Verified the plain key works directly via curl first, then fixed .bashrc (Vertex vars commented not deleted, GEMINI_API_KEY exported) and wrote tmux-gemini-session.sh (same survivability pattern as tmux-session.sh, defaults to -m gemini-2.5-flash since gemini-3.1-pro has zero free-tier quota). Verified in a genuinely clean shell. Real end-to-end test got past auth AND model routing, then hit a real, different, final blocker: 429 prepayment credits depleted on project einhorn-mjolnir -- a real GCP billing state, not fixable from this session, needs founder action at ai.studio/projects.

⚓ ☃
title: Fixed gemini CLI auth (API_KEY_INVALID); real billing blocker found beyond that
